products.label: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemerides JUP347 to JUP349
products.process: Take every confirmed moon of Jupiter in the pinned JPL catalogue that has no object package and has a Horizons code; ask Horizons for its geometric position relative to Jupiter's centre at the world's epoch; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: No colour is measured for these moons; every dot is the neutral grey the app gives a moon without a measured colour, and its size is a display choice.
